marseille.name: Tarot de Marseille
marseille.note: Classic Tarot de Marseille. Trump order is the historical one (VIII Justice, XI Force) - the reverse of Rider-Waite.

vieville.name: Tarot de Viéville
vieville.note: Jacques Viéville's tarot (Paris, c.1650), BnF scans. Printed trump order differs from Marseille: VII Justice, VIII Chariot, IX Force, XI Hermit.

visconti-sforza.name: Visconti-Sforza
visconti-sforza.note: Milan, c.1450-1470 (Bonifacio Bembo). Scans of an AGMuller facsimile by David Madore (2003). 73 cards: Devil, Tower, Knight of Coins and Three of Swords are lost; King of Cups is missing from this scan set.

oswald-wirth.name: Oswald Wirth Tarot
oswald-wirth.note: Oswald Wirth's esoteric tarot (Paris, 1889), BnF scans. Major arcana only (22 cards).
